title: 第166章 心里有几百只蚂蚁在爬
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

旁边的李娜听见这话，噗嗤一声笑了出来，“老板，你这就纯属嫉妒了。王大爷都七十多了，你去哪给他找保安的活啊。”

“就是，老板你赶紧吃面吧。等会还要回公司有事呢。”赵胖眼睛已经看向了端上来的辣椒炒肉拌面。

王海无奈地摇摇头，夹起一块裹满酱汁的五花肉塞进嘴里。肉片外皮微微发脆，油脂在口腔炸开，带着强烈的辣意。王海立刻把老爹的事情抛在脑后，埋头对付起眼前的面条。

下午四点。

店里的高峰期过去，舒书在一旁收拾空碗。范理靠在收银台后，拿出手机看了一眼时间。

才四点。

平时开店这四个小时，范理觉得过得飞快。随便下几碗面，跟食客扯几句淡，不知不觉就到六点了。但今天，时间就像被人按了慢放键。

范理抬头看了一眼墙上的挂钟。秒针一格一格地走，走得他心里直痒痒。

“叮铃。”

店门被推开。一对年轻情侣走了进来。男生熟练地走到桌前坐下，女生走到收银台。

“老板，两份清汤面，两杯豆浆。打包带走。”女生利索地付款。

范理点点头，转身进厨房操作，很快就打包好递给两人。

“老板，你今天怎么一直看时间？”舒书把抹布搭在肩上，有些好奇地问道。

范理摆摆手道，“没事，脖子有点酸，活动一下颈椎。”

话音刚落，门外传来一阵肆无忌惮的笑声。

范理转头透过玻璃门往外看。

唐记便利店门口放着两把遮阳伞和几张塑料椅。此刻，王大爷，李哥和许峰三人正坐在椅子上。每人手里拿着一瓶冰镇可乐。

唐芸和月儿站在旁边，正兴致勃勃地听他们聊天。

范理把耳朵凑近玻璃门。

“哎哟，这生活，太安逸了。”

许峰拧开瓶盖灌了一大口可乐，打了个悠长的饱嗝，“老谢店里那环境真不错，檀香一点，轻音乐一放，差点没给我睡过去。”

李哥翘起二郎腿，附和道，“确实。之前在外面按，按完浑身疼。今天这师傅手法正宗，踩背的力度刚刚好。”

王大爷把鸟笼放在桌上，往椅背上一靠，满脸回味，“那小姑娘手劲还挺大。我这老腰这段时间一直紧着，今天给她那么一推一揉，通透了！”

唐芸听得眼睛发亮，“王大爷，真有那么神？明天我也去试试。”

“去，必须去。老谢说了，天玺小区的商户和业主，这个月全部打八折！”许峰大手一挥。

“那明天上午我就去。”月儿在一旁搭腔。

范理站在店里，听着外面的对话，只觉得心里有几百只蚂蚁在爬。

Li Na next to her heard this and burst out laughing, "Boss, you are just jealous. Uncle Wang is over seventy, where can you find a job as a security guard for him?"

"That's right, boss, hurry up and eat the noodles. You have to go back to the company later to do something." Fatty Zhao's eyes were already looking at the noodles with fried pork and chili that were served.

Wang Hai shook his head helplessly, picked up a piece of pork belly covered in sauce and stuffed it into his mouth.The skin of the meat slices is slightly crispy, and the fat explodes in the mouth, with a strong spicy taste.Wang Hai immediately put his father's matter behind him and concentrated on dealing with the noodles in front of him.

4pm.

The peak period in the store has passed, and Shu Shu is collecting the empty bowls.Fan Li leaned behind the cashier, took out his cell phone and checked the time.

It's only four o'clock.

Fan Li felt that the four hours he usually spent opening the store flew by very quickly.I casually ordered a few bowls of noodles and chatted with the diners, and before I knew it, it was six o'clock.But today, time seems to have been pressed in slow motion.

Fan Li raised his head and glanced at the clock on the wall.The second hand moved tick by tick, making his heart itch.

"Dingle bell."

The store door was pushed open.A young couple walked in.The boy skillfully walked to the table and sat down, and the girl walked to the cashier.

"Boss, two portions of clear soup noodles and two cups of soy milk. Take them away." The girl paid neatly.

Fan Li nodded, turned around and went into the kitchen to operate, and quickly packed it and handed it to the two of them.

"Boss, why do you keep checking the time today?" Shu Shu put the rag on his shoulder and asked curiously.

Fan Li waved his hands and said, "It's okay. My neck is a little sore. Please move your cervical spine."

As soon as he finished speaking, there was a burst of unbridled laughter from outside the door.

Fan Li turned his head and looked out through the glass door.

There are two parasols and several plastic chairs at the entrance of Tangji convenience store.At this moment, Uncle Wang, Brother Li and Xu Feng are sitting on chairs.Each held a bottle of ice-cold Coke.

Tang Yun and Yue'er stood nearby, listening to their chat with great interest.

Fan Li put his ear close to the glass door.

"Oh, this life is so comfortable."

Xu Feng unscrewed the bottle cap and took a big gulp of Coke, then let out a long burp, "The environment in Lao Xie's store is really nice, with a little sandalwood and soft music, it almost made me fall asleep."

Brother Li crossed his legs and agreed, "Indeed. I used to press it outside, and my whole body hurt after pressing it. Today, the master's technique is authentic, and the strength of the step on the back is just right."

Uncle Wang put the birdcage on the table, leaned back in the chair, and said with a face full of aftertaste, "That little girl's hands are quite strong. My old waist has been tight these days, and after giving her such a push and rub today, it's clear!"

Tang Yun's eyes lit up when she heard this, "Uncle Wang, are you really that amazing? I'll try it tomorrow too."

"Go, you must go. Lao Xie said that all merchants and owners in Tianxi Community will receive a 20% discount this month!" Xu Feng waved his hand.

"Then I'll go tomorrow morning." Yue'er chatted from the side.

Fan Li stood in the store, listening to the conversation outside, and felt like hundreds of ants crawling in his heart.
